title: One Membership per Buyer — Loop+ Membership Terms
content:
**Clause.** A buyer holds at most one Loop+ membership at a time across all plans; a buyer who wants another plan switches the existing membership. Household adults and teens share the owner's membership and hold none of their own. A cancelled membership does not count.

The limit applies when a buyer signs up for a Loop+ Membership plan. The maximum number of Loop+ memberships one buyer may hold at a time is 1, counted across all six plans together rather than plan by plan.

## The clause in parts

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Limit | 1 Loop+ membership per buyer at a time |
| Scope of the count | all Loop+ Membership plans together |
| A buyer who wants another plan | switches the existing membership rather than signing up for a second one |
| Household adults and teens | share the owner's membership and hold none of their own |
| A cancelled membership | does not count toward the limit |

## Illustrations (hypothetical buyers)

- A buyer holds an active Loop+ Monthly membership and wants Loop+ Annual. The buyer already holds 1 membership, so the move to Loop+ Annual is made by switching the existing membership, not by a second sign-up.
- A buyer's only earlier Loop+ membership is in cancelled status. The cancelled membership does not count, so the buyer holds no membership for the purpose of the limit.
- A household adult on an owner's Loop+ Household Annual membership shares the owner's membership and holds no Loop+ membership of their own on that account.
